language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon in frames 73–80 and lifts it from the table in frames 84–93 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). It carries the spoon to the open drawer and lowers it over the drawer interior in frames 151–180 (image, wrist_image). In frames 181–186, wrist_image shows the fingers opening and the spoon descending into the drawer; the empty gripper then withdraws in frames 192–197. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
